test_pyspiel_load_game: test pyspiel.load_game to create a game instance from a registered game name like kuhn_poker
test_pyspiel_game_parameters: test pyspiel.game_parameters_from_string and game_parameters_to_string for serializing game parameters
test_pyspiel_struct_api: test pyspiel struct API including to_struct, to_observation_struct, action_to_struct, and struct_to_actions
test_pyspiel_state_round_trip: test pyspiel state to_dict and from_dict round-trip conversion for tic_tac_toe game states
test_pyspiel_load_game_from_json: test pyspiel.load_game_from_json to load a game from a JSON string with game_name and optional parameters
